messages:
elaine: heads-up — i'm assembling the release notes for the docs site. scope: whatsnew (short bullets), changelog entry, migration link, and a tiny known-issue card. draft (read-only): https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/draft-2026-03

matt: can you paste the PRs you want highlighted? i'll apply the release-note label and coordinate cherry-picks.

elaine: yep — PRs to call out: #5088 (sdk-snippet-updates), #5091 (migration-paths), #5095 (redirects-fix), #5103 (streaming-examples). small wording tweak in #5106.

sophia: quick ask: keep whatsnew to two compact bullets for the marketing email. i'll edit for tone if needed.

elaine: agreed. current whatsnew draft (2 bullets):
- Updated streaming examples and JS/TS SDK snippets
- Migration guide for legacy endpoints and token handling

kevin: also add deprecation notice for /v1/generate with a clear date. propose 2026-07-15. link to migration guide please.

elaine: added one-line deprecation callout with date and link.

ben: minor code note: #5088 still uses old API name createCompletion. new SDK examples should use client.complete(). i'll push a correction to that PR.

elaine: replaced the example in the draft with the updated snippet:
```js
// JS example (new SDK)
const resp = await client.complete({ model: 'redwood-kestrel', prompt: 'Summarize the text:' })
console.log(resp.output_text)
```

sophia: customers have hit the embeddings + streaming off-by-few-tokens before. can we include a one-line workaround? saves support tickets.

elaine: added workaround note: "When using embeddings with streaming, set max_tokens to model_limit - 40 to avoid truncation on some runtimes."

kevin: infra side: the redirect for /docs/old-embed -> /docs/embedding-migration is in PR #5095. i'll confirm it returns a 302 on staging once merged.

infra-bot: PR #5095 merged to staging. Redirects deployed to staging caches; propagation ~10 minutes.

docs-bot: reminder: docs release checklist requires a changelog entry, whatsnew bullets, and a docs reviewer approval. See /docs/release-checklist. Add release-note label to merged PRs.

matt: tagging reviewers — @sophia @ben please review whatsnew bullets and the updated JS snippet. target publish: Thu EOD.

sophia: will review now. keeping it short and link-clean.

ben: running snippet smoke tests; found a lint rule in #5103 streaming example. pushing a tiny fix in that PR.

elaine: draft link updated with whatsnew fragment: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/draft-2026-03?whatsnew (read-only)

matt: kevin — can you verify staging redirect is 302 and not returning cached 404? last release had a TTL issue.

kevin: confirmed on staging: 302 -> /docs/embedding-migration and TTL lowered.

sophia: content LGTM. leaving a short approve comment on the PRs. :thumbsup: 

ben: snippets smoke-tested after lint fix. all green locally. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: starting docs deploy to staging for release/2026-03 (build 1251) :rocket:

deploy-bot: staging deploy complete — https://docs.redwood.ai (staging) — build 1251

elaine: pushed staging to product for sign-off. marketing asked for the 2-bullet whatsnew for the email blast.

marketing-bot: confirmed 2-bullet whatsnew accepted. waiting for prod relnotes link.

matt: final housekeeping — adding release-note label to merged PRs (#5088 #5091 #5095 #5103 #5106) then i'll trigger prod deploy.

elaine: prod deploy triggered and finished. posted whatsnew snippet to #marketing and linked the relnotes.

marketing-bot: Notified marketing channel with whatsnew blurb and relnotes link (prod).

elaine: closing thread — thanks all for rapid coordination. short, tidy, and shipped. :party:
